summary: Fixes joinURL so path segments are inserted before the query string and hash, e.g. "/api?v=2" + "users" gives "/api/users?v=2", with tests.
narrative: The owner asked on 2026-11-02 for joinURL to stop appending segments after the query string or hash, with tests. The agent found that joinURL works on the raw string and does not use withTrailingSlash's query/fragment-aware mode (obs 6, 7). It patched joinURL and added query and hash cases; the first vitest run showed 5 failures (obs 8). It then moved the six new cases into their own describe block and ran the full suite. The join tests pass, and the only failures left are in the unimplemented isSameOrigin spec (obs 9). The owner said they were pushing the branch for this fix. Memory shows no merged PR or release, so the work is built and tested but not confirmed shipped.

milestones.text: Owner reported joinURL putting segments after the query string and asked for a fix with tests.
Root cause found: joinURL does not separate query and hash before appending segments.
joinURL patched and query/hash test cases added; first run had 5 failures.
Cases moved into their own describe block; full suite shows the join tests passing.

preferences.preference: Keep unrelated work (the isSameOrigin tests) untouched while pushing a focused fix branch.
